sourceTitle: A dissuasion to Great-Britain and the colonies, from the slave trade to Africa
description: "A dissuasion to Great-Britain and the colonies, from the slave trade to Africa" by James Swan is a philosophical treatise written in the late 18th century. This book effectively combines a moral argument with a critique of the slave trade, arguing against the practice as both unChristian and detrimental to the societies involved.
